We introduce PURE, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching covering four capability dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, and Evidence-grounded Judgment. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes.
